assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of intermittent palpitations and subjective awareness of irregular heartbeats, prompting further evaluation for suspected cardiac arrhythmia.
Diagnosis codes I49.9,R00.2 are associated with the case.
The monitoring is intended to capture electrocardiographic data during symptom onset to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying rhythm disturbances.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the suspected cardiac arrhythmia and correlate the palpitations with rhythm disturbances.
